trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Magic Kingdom, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando Boutique Stay
hotel.location: Magic Kingdom, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

day_by_day.morning: Arrival & Check-In — Flight lands at 13:00, so morning is in transit. Use Disney's Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Uber/Lyft) from Orlando International Airport to your boutique stay near Magic Kingdom/Lake Buena Vista. Estimated travel time: 30–45 minutes.
day_by_day.afternoon: After check-in, head to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket needed) for a relaxed first afternoon. Explore the outdoor shopping and entertainment district, window-shop at Disney merchandise stores, and get your bearings. Walk along the waterfront and enjoy the lively atmosphere — great way to ease into the Disney magic without spending on park tickets.
day_by_day.evening: Stay at Disney Springs for the evening. Catch free live music performances at the Marketplace Stage or West Side venues. Browse the LEGO Store (free to enter and explore) and watch the nightly entertainment. End the night with a stroll along the waterfront before heading back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Grab a snack or light meal at the airport before landing — budget around $10–12. Alternatively, pick up groceries at a nearby Publix or Walmart after check-in to stock your room with breakfast items for the week (saves significant money).
meals.lunch: Grab a quick and affordable bite at Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza at Disney Springs (~$10–13 per person) — build-your-own pizza at a great price point.
meals.dinner: Earl of Sandwich at Disney Springs — one of the most budget-friendly and beloved quick-service spots on Disney property. Hearty sandwiches for around $8–11 each. Try the Original 1762 sandwich.

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 is intentionally light on spending. Use this afternoon to purchase a reusable water bottle (available at Disney Springs) — Disney parks offer free ice water at any quick-service location, saving you hundreds on beverages. Also download the My Disney Experience app tonight and link your park tickets if not already done. Stock your hotel room with snacks and breakfast items from a nearby grocery store to cut daily food costs significantly.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom — Arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM) to maximize your time before crowds build. Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, then swing through Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (use Lightning Lane if budget allows, otherwise use the Single Rider or early morning advantage). Hit Peter Pan's Flight and it's a Small World back-to-back.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue through Magic Kingdom — explore Adventureland (Pirates of the Caribbean, Jungle Cruise), Liberty Square (Haunted Mansion), and Frontierland (Big Thunder Mountain Railroad). Take a mid-afternoon break during peak heat (2–4 PM) by enjoying indoor air-conditioned attractions like the Walt Disney World Railroad or the Hall of Presidents.
day_by_day.evening: Position yourself on Main Street U.S.A. or the Hub Grass area in front of Cinderella Castle for the nightly fireworks show — Disney Enchantment or the current nighttime spectacular (free with park admission). This is a bucket-list moment and costs nothing extra. Exit the park after fireworks using resort buses back to your hotel.

meals.breakfast: Eat breakfast at your hotel room using groceries purchased on Day 1 (cereal, fruit, granola bars) — save $10–15 per person.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — one of Magic Kingdom's best quick-service spots. Try the lobster roll or chicken sandwich combo (~$12–15). Eat early (11:30 AM) to avoid lines.
meals.dinner: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn & Café in Frontierland — hearty Tex-Mex bowls and burgers for ~$12–14. Take advantage of the free toppings bar (lettuce, tomatoes, salsa, cheese) to bulk up your meal at no extra cost.

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable, closed-toe shoes and bring a small backpack with sunscreen, a refillable water bottle, and light snacks (granola bars, trail mix) from your hotel room stash. Florida heat in June is intense — plan to hydrate constantly and use the free ice water trick at any quick-service counter. Arrive at the park 30 minutes before official opening for the best ride access.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT — Arrive at rope drop and head directly to Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (use the virtual queue, which opens at 7:00 AM on the My Disney Experience app — set an alarm!). Then ride Test Track and Mission: SPACE back-to-back while crowds are light in Future World/World Discovery.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring EPCOT's World Showcase — the 11 international pavilions around the lagoon are free to walk through with park admission. Browse the shops, watch free cultural performances, and enjoy the architecture and theming of countries like Japan, Morocco, France, Italy, and Mexico. Ride Frozen Ever After in the Norway Pavilion and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France Pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's Harmonious or current nighttime lagoon spectacular — one of the largest nighttime shows Disney produces, completely free with park admission. Watch from the World Showcase Lagoon promenade. Head back to the hotel via Disney bus after the show.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast — fruit, instant oatmeal, or cereal from your grocery stash.
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion (Future World) — EPCOT's best quick-service value with rotating seasonal options, sandwiches, and hot meals for ~$11–14. Eat at 11:30 AM before the lunch rush.
meals.dinner: Explore World Showcase for budget dining — Tangierine Café in the Morocco Pavilion offers flavorful shawarma and falafel platters for ~$12–15. Alternatively, grab crepes from the France Pavilion outdoor kiosk (~$6–8) as a lighter, cheaper dinner option combined with a snack.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is extremely walkable — the World Showcase loop is 1.2 miles around. Wear sunscreen and a hat. The International Food & Wine Festival (if running in June 2027) offers small-plate tastings for $4–9 each — a fun, budget-friendly way to sample global cuisine without committing to a full meal. Check the EPCOT app for free cultural performances and demonstrations scheduled throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios — Arrive at rope drop and make a beeline for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive rides — get there early or use Lightning Lane). Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run in Galaxy's Edge and explore the Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge land, which is an attraction in itself with incredible theming and free interactive experiences.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers (shorter waits in the afternoon for the latter). Then experience The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith in Sunset Boulevard. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular — a free live show included with park admission that runs multiple times daily.
day_by_day.evening: End the night with Fantasmic! — Hollywood Studios' legendary nighttime lagoon show featuring Mickey Mouse, Disney villains, and spectacular water/fire effects. Completely free with park admission. Arrive 45–60 minutes early for a good viewing spot. Return to hotel via Disney transport.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast from grocery supplies.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — a fan-favorite quick-service with nostalgic lunch box tarts, grilled cheese, and BBQ brisket melts for ~$9–13. Try the Lunch Box Tart for a sweet treat (~$4).
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary near the park's center — solid quick-service with burgers, wraps, and international-inspired plates for ~$11–14. Air-conditioned and typically less crowded than other dining spots.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of Disney's most intense parks in terms of crowd flow — the rope drop strategy is critical here. Download the Boarding Group instructions for Rise of the Resistance before your visit and have the app ready at 7:00 AM. Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge offers free interactive experiences throughout the land (droids, stormtroopers, Resistance members) that cost nothing and add immense entertainment value.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom — Arrive at rope drop and rush to Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora: The World of Avatar. This is consistently one of Disney World's most popular rides with the longest waits — getting there at opening is essential. Ride Na'vi River Journey immediately after in the same Pandora land.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Animal Kingdom — ride Expedition Everest in Asia (a thrilling roller coaster), DINOSAUR in DinoLand U.S.A., and Kilimanjaro Safaris in Africa (best done in the morning or late afternoon for active animal sightings, so consider a second ride if time allows). Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek — free self-guided wildlife trails included with admission.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Rivers of Light or the current nighttime show at Animal Kingdom (verify show schedule for 2027). Explore Discovery Island at dusk when the park lighting creates a magical atmosphere. The Tree of Life comes alive with projected animal imagery after dark — a stunning and free visual experience. Return to hotel.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of Disney World's most praised quick-service restaurants. Healthy, customizable grain bowls with protein toppings for ~$13–16. Eat at 11:30 AM to beat the lunch rush.
meals.dinner: Flame Tree Barbecue on Discovery Island — open-air waterfront BBQ with ribs, chicken, and pulled pork platters for ~$12–16. Great views of the park's waterways. Try the half-chicken with two sides.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom opens early (often 8:00 AM) and some animals are most active in cooler morning hours — the Kilimanjaro Safaris is best experienced at rope drop or in the late afternoon. Bring bug spray (the park is an outdoor nature environment). The park also tends to close earlier than other Disney parks — check the 2027 schedule. June heat is significant — the shaded jungle paths of the wildlife trails offer a cool respite.

day_by_day.morning: Resort Pool Day & Free Disney Resort Hopping — Take a well-deserved rest morning at your boutique hotel pool. Many Disney-area hotels have themed pools. Alternatively, use Disney's free resort monorail/boat system to visit the Grand Floridian, Polynesian, and Contemporary resorts along the Magic Kingdom monorail loop — all free to explore as a guest. Walk the lobbies, enjoy the theming, and take photos at no cost.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Disney Springs for any last-minute shopping, souvenir hunting, or experiences missed on Day 1. Visit the free World of Disney store (largest Disney merchandise store in the world), check out the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater (matinee movies are budget-friendly if you want air-conditioned entertainment), or try one of the free interactive experiences around the shopping complex.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a relaxed final full evening at Disney Springs — catch free live music at multiple venues throughout the complex. The Marketplace area has waterfront seating perfect for people-watching. Consider a fun splurge dessert experience as a trip treat — Amorette's Patisserie has stunning pastries and cakes (~$8–12 each) worth the occasional indulgence.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast — use up remaining grocery supplies.
meals.lunch: Chicken Guy! at Disney Springs (Guy Fieri's restaurant) — tenders and sauces combo for ~$10–13. Casual, fast, and delicious.
meals.dinner: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — gourmet burgers with creative toppings for ~$12–15. One of the best burger values on Disney property. Eat outdoors at the waterfront seating area.

day_by_day.notes: Saturday is typically the busiest day at all Disney parks — if you have a park ticket available, consider using it on a weekday instead and keeping Saturday as a free/low-cost day. This is a great day to do laundry if your hotel has facilities, repack, and rest tired feet. Check the My Disney Experience app for any special events or free entertainment happening at Disney Springs tonight.

day_by_day.morning: Early breakfast at the hotel and final packing. If your flight is in the afternoon or evening, store luggage at the hotel's bell services. Take one last stroll through your hotel grounds or the nearby resort area. If time permits, revisit your favorite Magic Kingdom area for a quick final morning visit — rope drop access means shorter lines on departure day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on flight time — head to Orlando International Airport via rideshare (Uber/Lyft estimated $25–35 from Disney area) or Disney's Magical Express equivalent service. Arrive at the airport at least 2.5 hours before departure for domestic flights, 3 hours for international. Browse the airport shops for any last-minute affordable Florida/Disney souvenirs (airport Disney Store often has clearance items).
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Orlando International Airport. Reflect on an incredible week of Disney magic on a budget!

meals.breakfast: Final hotel room breakfast — finish all remaining grocery supplies to avoid waste. Supplement with any leftover snacks.
meals.lunch: If still on Disney property mid-morning: grab a quick and affordable bite at a resort quick-service location. If at the airport: budget $12–15 for airport food (Chick-fil-A and Burger King are available at MCO at reasonable prices compared to other airport options).
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport dining depending on departure time.

day_by_day.notes: Budget Summary Tips for the Week: (1) Grocery store run on Day 1 saves approximately $70–100 in breakfast costs over 7 days. (2) Free ice water at any Disney quick-service counter saves $30–50 in beverage costs. (3) Free toppings bars at Pecos Bill and similar locations add value to quick-service meals. (4) Disney Springs requires NO park ticket — 2 full days of entertainment at zero admission cost. (5) Resort hopping via monorail/boat is completely free and offers world-class theming. (6) Arriving at rope drop for every park day saves money on Lightning Lane purchases by accessing top rides before crowds build. Estimated daily food budget per person: $25–40 using the strategies above.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival & Check-In — Flight lands at 13:00, so no morning activities. Use this time to rest on the plane and prepare your park plans.
day_by_day.afternoon: Airport to Resort Transfer & Hotel Check-In — Take Disney's Magical Express or a rideshare from Orlando International Airport to your Boutique Stay near Magic Kingdom. Get settled, pick up your MagicBands or park tickets, download the My Disney Experience app, and take a leisurely stroll around the resort grounds to get oriented. Grab a welcome snack and review your week's FastPass/Lightning Lane reservations.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Welcome Night — Head to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket needed) for a relaxed first evening. Explore the shops, catch live street entertainment, and enjoy a casual dinner. Browse World of Disney, check out the LEGO store, and soak in the atmosphere without the pressure of a full park day.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the plane or grab a quick snack at Orlando International Airport — Starbucks or a grab-and-go option in the terminal.
meals.lunch: Arrive and settle in — light snack from the resort gift shop or quick-service option at your hotel to tide you over.
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — mid-range waterfront dining with fresh seafood, steaks, and burgers. Expect $20–$40 per entrée. Reservations recommended but walk-ins often available on weekdays.

day_by_day.notes: Since arrival is at 13:00, keep Day 1 low-key to recover from travel. Pre-book Lightning Lane Multi Pass selections for the rest of the week using the My Disney Experience app as soon as you check in. Purchase a refillable resort mug if your hotel offers one for cost savings on drinks throughout the week.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park — Arrive at rope drop (park typically opens at 9:00 AM; arrive by 8:30 AM for early entry if staying on-site). Hit the most popular rides first: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Use Lightning Lane selections strategically for the longest queues.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom Continued — After lunch, explore Fantasyland (Peter Pan's Flight, It's a Small World, The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh) and Tomorrowland (Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin, Tron Lightcycle Run if available). Take a mid-afternoon break back at the hotel during the hottest hours (2:00–4:00 PM) to recharge.
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom Evening Magic — Return to the park for the cooler evening hours. Experience the Festival of Fantasy Parade and stay for the Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle (typically around 9:00 PM). This is a bucket-list Disney moment.

meals.breakfast: Resort hotel breakfast — most mid-range Disney resorts offer a quick-service breakfast. Grab Mickey waffles or a continental spread at your hotel before rope drop.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — a mid-range quick-service spot offering clam chowder, lobster rolls, and fried chicken. Budget-friendly at $12–$18 per person.
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Fantasyland — mid-range table-service dining inside Beast's Castle. Prix-fixe dinner menu around $60–$75 per adult. Book well in advance. Alternatively, Tony's Town Square Restaurant near the park entrance offers Italian classics at similar pricing.

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom Full Day Experience. Take advantage of Disney Resort early park entry (30 minutes before official opening) to beat crowds on top-tier attractions. Wear comfortable shoes — expect 8–12 miles of walking. Stay hydrated; June in Orlando is hot and humid with temperatures near 90°F.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT for opening (typically 9:00 AM). Start with Future World/World Discovery to ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track early before crowds build. Then transition to the World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Exploration — Walk the World Showcase promenade and explore pavilions from Mexico, Norway (Frozen Ever After ride), China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France (Remy's Ratatouille Adventure), United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample international snacks and beverages at each pavilion. This is a perfect mid-range foodie experience.
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT Harmonious Nighttime Spectacular — Stay for EPCOT's stunning nighttime lagoon show featuring fireworks, fountains, and projections (typically around 9:00 PM). Grab a spot around World Showcase Lagoon 30–45 minutes early for the best views.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion at EPCOT — excellent quick-service breakfast with fresh options including egg dishes, pastries, and fruit. Around $10–$15 per person.
meals.lunch: La Cantina de San Angel in the Mexico Pavilion — outdoor waterfront quick-service with tacos, nachos, and margaritas. Budget $15–$22 per person. Enjoy views of the World Showcase Lagoon.
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion — mid-range hibachi-style teppanyaki dining with entertaining tableside cooking. Approximately $30–$50 per adult. Reservations strongly recommended.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour Experience. EPCOT is the most walkable park — the World Showcase loop is 1.3 miles. Pace yourselves and take breaks in air-conditioned pavilions. If traveling with young children, Norway's Frozen Ever After and Mexico's Gran Fiesta Tour are gentle boat rides perfect for a midday cool-down.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios — Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Arrive at rope drop for Hollywood Studios. Head straight to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Attempt to ride Rise of the Resistance first (one of Disney's most immersive attractions) and then Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Book a time slot for Savi's Workshop (lightsaber building — approximately $250 per lightsaber, pre-book well in advance) if budget allows.
day_by_day.afternoon: Hollywood Studios Broader Exploration — After Galaxy's Edge, explore Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Toy Story Mania), ride Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster in Sunset Boulevard, and catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show. Take a short midday break or enjoy a sit-down lunch to escape the heat.
day_by_day.evening: Hollywood Studios Nighttime Shows — Experience the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks and projection show over the Chinese Theatre (typically 9:30 PM). Also check the schedule for Fantasmic!, the dramatic nighttime water and fire show — a Hollywood Studios highlight.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at your resort before heading to Hollywood Studios — grab a pastry and coffee from the hotel quick-service or pack a light snack.
meals.lunch: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant — a unique mid-range table-service experience where you eat in retro cars watching classic sci-fi movie clips. Burgers, sandwiches, and milkshakes around $18–$30 per person. Reservations recommended.
meals.dinner: Oga's Cantina in Galaxy's Edge for drinks and appetizers (standing room, 45-minute limit) followed by dinner at Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo — the best quick-service in Galaxy's Edge with creative Star Wars-themed dishes around $15–$20 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios Star Wars Galaxy's Edge Experience. This is typically the most crowd-heavy day activity. Lightning Lane purchases for Rise of the Resistance are highly recommended. If Savi's Workshop is a priority, it must be booked 60 days in advance via My Disney Experience — it sells out quickly.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom — Safari & Avatar Experience — Arrive early for Kilimanjaro Safaris (best wildlife sightings are in the cooler morning hours when animals are most active). See lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, and more on this 18-minute open-vehicle safari. Follow up with the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for a walking wildlife experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pandora — The World of Avatar — Head to Pandora for Avatar Flight of Passage (the park's premier attraction — use Lightning Lane) and the Na'vi River Journey. Explore the bioluminescent landscape of Pandora, which is especially magical. Also visit DinoLand U.S.A. and Discovery Island for additional attractions like Expedition Everest.
day_by_day.evening: Animal Kingdom Rivers of Light or Resort Relaxation — Check if Rivers of Light or Tree of Life Awakenings (nighttime projection show on the Tree of Life) is scheduled. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (around 8:00–9:00 PM). Use the extra evening time to relax at your resort, swim in the hotel pool, or do light shopping.

meals.breakfast: Grab-and-go from your resort — pack snacks like granola bars and fruit for the early morning safari to maximize wildlife-viewing time.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — the best quick-service in Animal Kingdom. Customizable bowls with proteins like slow-roasted Ronyx and chili-spiced crispy chicken over grains and vegetables. Around $14–$18 per person. Highly rated for quality.
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia — mid-range table-service with Asian-fusion cuisine including honey chicken, Kobe beef burgers, and dim sum. Around $20–$35 per person. Alternatively, enjoy a relaxed dinner at your resort restaurant.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience. Pandora at night is breathtaking — the bioluminescent plants glow and the entire land transforms. If Animal Kingdom closes early, consider returning to Disney Springs for evening entertainment or catching a Disney movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day — Start the morning leisurely with a late hotel breakfast since Disney Springs opens at 10:00 AM (shops) with restaurants opening for lunch. Explore the shopping districts: The Landing, Marketplace, Town Center, and West Side. Visit the LEGO Store, World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store in the world), and Art of Disney gallery.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Activities & Entertainment — Enjoy free live entertainment on the outdoor stages throughout the day. Visit Splitsville Luxury Lanes for bowling and entertainment (mid-range pricing, $15–$20 per person per game). Check out the Disney Springs Marketplace Co-Op for unique merchandise. If traveling with kids, the LEGO fountain play area and outdoor spaces are great for free fun.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dinner & Entertainment Night — Enjoy a special dinner at one of Disney Springs' signature restaurants. Catch any scheduled live music events (Disney Springs regularly features free live bands and performers throughout the evening). End the night with a dessert treat — try a gourmet cupcake from Amorette's Patisserie or a specialty item from Ghirardelli.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast — take your time this morning. Enjoy the hotel's dining options or order room service as a mid-trip treat.
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — gourmet burgers with creative toppings in a quick-service setting. Around $15–$20 per person. Great mid-range option with outdoor seating.
meals.dinner: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — upscale-casual steakhouse with a fun atmosphere, creative cocktails, and excellent steaks. Splurge-worthy dinner around $45–$70 per person for a special mid-trip celebration. Alternatively, Paddlefish (seafood, similar price range) or Raglan Road Irish Pub (lively atmosphere, $20–$35 per person with live Irish entertainment) are excellent mid-range options.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day — no park ticket required! This is a great budget-saving day since there are no park admission costs. Use this day to recharge after four consecutive park days. Pick up any souvenirs or gifts here as Disney Springs often has the same merchandise as the parks without the crowds.

day_by_day.morning: Return to Favorite Park or Resort Morning — On your final full day, revisit your favorite park for a morning session, or enjoy a relaxed resort morning. If returning to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT, use any remaining Lightning Lane credits and revisit must-do attractions you may have missed or want to experience again. Alternatively, spend a final morning at the resort pool.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final Souvenir Shopping & Packing — Begin packing and check-out preparations. If you have a late departure the following day, enjoy one last resort activity. Visit the hotel gift shop for any final souvenirs. Take a final walk around the resort to soak in the ambiance. If time allows, visit a park for a short afternoon session using any remaining park reservations.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell Dinner & Magic Kingdom Fireworks Send-Off — End your Disney World trip with a memorable farewell dinner followed by watching the Magic Kingdom fireworks from the resort area or Seven Seas Lagoon shoreline (visible from many Magic Kingdom area resorts without a park ticket). Reflect on the week's magical memories.

meals.breakfast: Chef Mickey's at Disney's Contemporary Resort — iconic character dining with Mickey, Minnie, and friends. Buffet-style breakfast around $42–$55 per adult, $27–$35 per child. A perfect final-morning splurge and memorable send-off with the characters. Book 60 days in advance.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at your resort quick-service or pack snacks if spending time at a park for the afternoon.
meals.dinner: California Grill atop Disney's Contemporary Resort — a signature dining experience with panoramic views of Magic Kingdom and the fireworks. Prix-fixe or à la carte options around $50–$80 per adult. Guests can step outside on the observation deck to watch the Magic Kingdom fireworks with music piped in — a truly magical farewell. Reservations essential, book 60 days ahead.

day_by_day.notes: Final Day — Make it count! Check Disney's My Disney Experience app for any last-minute Lightning Lane availability for rides you haven't yet experienced. If departing on June 22nd, arrange airport transportation the night before. Disney's Magical Express or Mears Connect should be booked in advance. Leave extra time for airport security — Orlando International can be very busy on summer Sunday evenings. Consider using Disney's Resort Airline Check-In service if available to check luggage directly from your hotel.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Disney World, Orlando, Florida Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: Magic Kingdom, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando Boutique Stay
hotel.location: Magic Kingdom, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day
experiences.description: Experience the iconic Magic Kingdom with classic rides like Space Mountain, Pirates of the Caribbean, and the Haunted Mansion. Watch the Festival of Fantasy parade and end the night with the spectacular Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle.
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase featuring 11 country pavilions with authentic cuisine, cultural performances, and immersive experiences. Sample dishes from Mexico, Japan, France, and Morocco while enjoying live entertainment and the stunning EPCOT Forever nighttime spectacular.
experiences.location: EPCOT World Showcase, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
experiences.description: Immerse your family in the Star Wars universe at Galaxy's Edge. Build your own lightsaber at Savi's Workshop, pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run, and experience the thrilling Rise of the Resistance ride. Enjoy themed food and drinks at Oga's Cantina.
experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Galaxy's Edge, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day
experiences.description: Spend a fun-filled day at Disney Springs with no park ticket required. Enjoy live entertainment, visit the LEGO Store, dine at family-friendly restaurants like T-REX Cafe or The Boathouse, catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24, and browse unique Disney merchandise and experiences.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience
experiences.description: Embark on the Kilimanjaro Safaris to see real African wildlife including lions, elephants, and giraffes. Then journey to Pandora - The World of Avatar for the breathtaking Flight of Passage ride and the Na'vi River Journey. Enjoy a family dinner at Tiffins restaurant with globally inspired cuisine.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Pandora - World of Avatar, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

day_by_day.morning: Arrival & Hotel Check-In: Flight LH lands at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled. Upon landing, arrange private luxury transfer (pre-booked limousine or Disney's Magical Express premium service) from Orlando International Airport to your Boutique Stay at Magic Kingdom, Lake Buena Vista. Enjoy a seamless, stress-free arrival experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Orientation & Magic Kingdom First Impressions: After checking in and freshening up, take a leisurely stroll through the Magic Kingdom resort area. Visit the iconic Main Street, U.S.A. for a relaxed introduction to the park atmosphere. Enjoy the afternoon ambiance, browse premium merchandise shops, and capture photos of Cinderella Castle without the full-day crowd fatigue. Purchase or confirm your Disney Park Hopper Plus passes at the concierge desk.
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom Evening Spectacular: Head into Magic Kingdom for the evening to experience the breathtaking 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks show and 'Happily Ever After' nighttime spectacular over Cinderella Castle. Enjoy a few signature evening rides such as Pirates of the Caribbean and the Haunted Mansion with shorter wait times. Conclude with a relaxing walk back to the boutique hotel.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy breakfast on the flight or grab a light snack at the airport before departure.
meals.lunch: The Contemporary Resort's California Grill (adjacent to Magic Kingdom) — enjoy panoramic views and a sophisticated menu featuring fresh seafood, artisan flatbreads, and premium cocktails.
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table inside Magic Kingdom — a signature dining experience inside Cinderella Castle with a prix-fixe menu featuring roasted prime beef tenderloin, pan-seared salmon, and decadent desserts. Book the evening seating to coincide with the fireworks view from the castle windows.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-book Cinderella's Royal Table well in advance (60-day booking window). Arrange private airport transfer before travel. Request early check-in at the boutique hotel if possible. Pack light for the evening park visit — a small bag with essentials only. Dress code at California Grill is smart casual.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day — Morning Rush: Arrive at Magic Kingdom at rope drop (typically 8:00–9:00 AM) using your resort's early park entry benefit (Disney hotel guests get 30 minutes early access). Prioritize the most popular attractions first: Space Mountain, Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, and Tomorrowland Speedway. Use Disney Genie+ Lightning Lane selections strategically for top-tier rides.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom Continued — Afternoon Exploration: After a midday break back at the hotel (take advantage of the resort proximity), return to Magic Kingdom refreshed. Experience Fantasyland's iconic rides: Peter Pan's Flight, 'it's a small world,' and the Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade at 3:00 PM — a vibrant, elaborate procession through Main Street, U.S.A. Explore Liberty Square and Frontierland for Big Thunder Mountain Railroad.
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom Nighttime Magic: Stay for the full evening experience including the Move It! Shake It! MousekeDance It! Street Party and the grand nighttime fireworks spectacular. Enjoy the illuminated Cinderella Castle and leisurely stroll Main Street, U.S.A. as the park winds down. Take advantage of reduced crowds in the final hour before park close.

meals.breakfast: Topolino's Terrace – Flavors of the Riviera at Disney's Riviera Resort: A character breakfast featuring Mickey, Minnie, Donald, and Daisy in French Riviera attire. Enjoy crêpes, quiche, charcuterie boards, and fresh-pressed juices with stunning rooftop views.
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant (Magic Kingdom): Dine in the enchanted Beast's Castle with a prix-fixe lunch menu featuring French-inspired cuisine — pan-seared salmon, braised pork, and the famous grey stuff dessert in the elegant West Wing or Rose Gallery dining rooms.
meals.dinner: Narcoossee's at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa: A waterfront fine dining experience accessible by complimentary boat from Magic Kingdom. Savor Maine lobster bisque, pan-seared scallops, and prime filet mignon while watching Magic Kingdom fireworks reflect over the Seven Seas Lagoon.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Individual Lightning Lane selections for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and TRON Lightcycle Run as these sell out quickly. Wear comfortable walking shoes and use the My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times in real time. Narcoossee's reservations should be timed to coincide with the fireworks viewing from the waterfront terrace.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Morning Discovery: Arrive at EPCOT for early park entry. Begin with Future World (now called World Discovery and World Nature) — experience Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind, Test Track, and Soarin' Around the World. Use Lightning Lane for Cosmic Rewind as it is virtual-queue only. Explore the stunning EPCOT Flower & Garden Festival displays (June seasonal event).
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Culinary Journey: Transition to the World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM. Embark on a self-guided premium food and beverage tour across the 11 country pavilions — sample authentic Japanese ramen and sake in Japan, handcrafted crepes in France, fresh ceviche and margaritas in Mexico's La Cava del Tequila, and artisan cheeses in the France pavilion. Enjoy cultural performances, artisan demonstrations, and immersive architecture throughout the afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT Harmonious Nighttime Spectacular: Stay for EPCOT's signature 'Harmonious' nighttime show — one of the largest nighttime spectaculars ever created at Disney, featuring floating set pieces, fountains, pyrotechnics, and projections on World Showcase Lagoon. Secure a premium viewing spot near the America pavilion waterfront at least 45 minutes early.

meals.breakfast: The Garden View Tea Room at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort: An elegant morning tea service featuring freshly baked scones, finger sandwiches, seasonal pastries, and premium loose-leaf teas — a refined start to a culturally rich day.
meals.lunch: Monsieur Paul at EPCOT (France Pavilion): An upscale French fine dining restaurant inspired by legendary chef Paul Bocuse. Indulge in classic French onion soup, duck confit, and a decadent chocolate fondant — arguably the most refined lunch experience in all of Walt Disney World.
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo at EPCOT (Japan Pavilion): An interactive and theatrical teppanyaki dining experience featuring premium Wagyu beef, fresh seafood, and seasonal vegetables prepared tableside by skilled chefs. Pair with premium sake selections for an authentic and memorable evening.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase opens at 11:00 AM — plan Future World attractions for the morning. La Cava del Tequila is walk-up only (no reservations) so visit early afternoon to avoid long waits. Monsieur Paul requires advance reservations. The Harmonious show typically runs at 9:00 PM — confirm showtimes via My Disney Experience app.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios — Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Morning Mission: Arrive at Hollywood Studios for early park entry. Head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at the back of the park. Begin with Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run — secure your role as pilot for the best experience. Then join the virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance, one of the most technologically advanced theme park attractions in the world. Explore Black Spire Outpost's immersive theming, interact with Stormtroopers and droids, and browse Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities for rare collectibles.
day_by_day.afternoon: Savi's Workshop Lightsaber Building & Galaxy's Edge Deep Dive: Book the premium Savi's Workshop — Handbuilt Lightsabers experience (approximately $299 per lightsaber). Choose from four unique themes (Peace and Justice, Power and Control, Elemental Nature, Protection and Defense) and assemble your custom lightsaber in a ceremonial, story-driven environment. Afterward, visit Droid Depot to build a custom droid companion. Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Toy Story Land, The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror, and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith.
day_by_day.evening: Hollywood Studios Fantasmic! & Sunset Dining: Experience Fantasmic! — Hollywood Studios' legendary nighttime show featuring Mickey Mouse in an epic battle of imagination with water screens, pyrotechnics, and live performers. Upgrade to the Fantasmic! Dining Package for reserved premium seating. Afterward, explore the Hollywood Boulevard atmosphere and enjoy an evening cocktail at Baseline Tap House.

meals.breakfast: Oga's Cantina at Hollywood Studios (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge): An immersive, reservation-required bar experience inside Galaxy's Edge. Enjoy themed cocktails, non-alcoholic concoctions, and light bites in the most atmospheric bar in theme park history — surrounded by alien creatures and DJ R-3X spinning intergalactic beats.
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Galaxy's Edge): Dine on inventive Star Wars-themed cuisine including the Smoked Kaadu Ribs (smoked pork ribs), Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (roasted chicken), and exotic blue and green milk — all served in an authentic cargo bay setting within Black Spire Outpost.
meals.dinner: The Hollywood Brown Derby at Hollywood Studios: A recreation of the legendary 1930s Hollywood supper club. Savor the signature Cobb salad prepared tableside, pan-seared duck breast, and decadent grapefruit cake in an atmosphere adorned with celebrity caricatures — the most elegant dining option at Hollywood Studios.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations open 60 days in advance and sell out extremely fast — book immediately upon your 60-day window opening. Oga's Cantina has a 45-minute time limit per visit and reservations are highly recommended. The Fantasmic! Dining Package must be booked separately and includes a reserved viewing section. Bring your newly built lightsaber to Galaxy's Edge interactions for enhanced character responses from cast members.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom — Kilimanjaro Safaris & Wildlife Immersion: Arrive at Animal Kingdom for early park entry. Head directly to Kilimanjaro Safaris for the first safari of the day — animals are most active in the cooler morning hours. Spot lions, African elephants, giraffes, zebras, white rhinos, hippos, and hundreds of bird species across the 110-acre savanna. Follow with Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for close-up wildlife encounters. Visit the Tree of Life for its stunning intricate carvings featuring 325 animals.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pandora — The World of Avatar Experience: Transition to Pandora – The World of Avatar, Animal Kingdom's most immersive land. Experience Avatar Flight of Passage — widely regarded as one of the greatest theme park attractions ever built — soaring on a banshee over the bioluminescent landscape of Pandora. Follow with Na'vi River Journey for a serene boat ride through a mystical rainforest. Explore the lush bioluminescent theming of Pandora's landscape, interact with cast members speaking Na'vi, and browse Windtraders shop for unique Avatar merchandise.
day_by_day.evening: Animal Kingdom Rivers of Light & Bioluminescent Pandora: As dusk falls, Pandora transforms into a breathtaking bioluminescent wonderland — the plants, pathways, and floating mountains glow in vivid blues and purples. This is one of the most magical experiences at Walt Disney World, best appreciated in the evening. Enjoy a final walk through Discovery Island and Harambe Market before departing.

meals.breakfast: Boma — Flavors of Africa at Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge: An award-winning African-inspired buffet breakfast featuring bobotie (South African spiced meat), pap (cornmeal porridge), exotic fruit platters, and freshly baked breads — a culturally rich and delicious start to your wildlife day. Giraffes and zebras often graze on the savanna visible from the resort.
meals.lunch: Tiffins Restaurant at Animal Kingdom: Disney's most upscale Animal Kingdom dining experience, inspired by the global travels of Disney Imagineers. Enjoy whole-fried sustainable fish, braised short rib, and artisan cheese boards in an elegantly appointed restaurant filled with original artwork and travel memorabilia. Reserve the Nomad Lounge adjacent for pre-lunch cocktails.
meals.dinner: Jiko — The Cooking Place at Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge: One of Walt Disney World's finest signature restaurants. Indulge in wood-fired South African cuisine featuring oak-grilled filet mignon, Durban-spiced lamb chops, and an extraordinary African wine list — the most extensive collection of African wines in North America. A truly world-class dining experience.

day_by_day.notes: Avatar Flight of Passage consistently has the longest wait times in all of Walt Disney World — arrive at rope drop or use Individual Lightning Lane. Kilimanjaro Safaris offers a 'Wild Africa Trek' premium guided experience ($189–$249 per person) for those seeking an even more exclusive behind-the-scenes wildlife encounter — book separately. Jiko and Boma reservations at Animal Kingdom Lodge are extremely popular — book 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Morning: Begin the day with a relaxed, no-park-ticket-required morning at Disney Springs. Explore the vibrant waterfront marketplace with over 150 shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues. Visit the LEGO Store's outdoor building area, browse World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store on property), and explore the unique artisan boutiques. Enjoy the laid-back atmosphere before the afternoon crowds arrive.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Premium Experiences & Entertainment: Visit Splitsville Luxury Lanes for upscale bowling combined with a full restaurant menu — a unique family entertainment experience. Explore Cirque du Soleil's 'Drawn to Life' show (a collaboration between Cirque du Soleil and Walt Disney Animation Studios featuring a story of a young girl who discovers her father's unfinished Disney animation). Book premium reserved seating for the afternoon performance. Browse the NBA Experience and browse Art of Disney gallery for collectible artwork.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Waterfront Dining & Live Entertainment: Enjoy the vibrant evening atmosphere at Disney Springs with live music performances throughout the waterfront. Browse the illuminated marketplace, enjoy a premium dessert experience, and soak in the festive atmosphere. This is an ideal evening for souvenir shopping, relaxed exploration, and celebrating the penultimate night of your luxury Disney vacation.

meals.breakfast: Paddlefish at Disney Springs: Housed in a reimagined multi-deck steamboat, enjoy a sophisticated seafood brunch featuring lobster eggs Benedict, smoked salmon platters, and freshly shucked oysters with panoramic waterfront views.
meals.lunch: The Boathouse at Disney Springs: A nautical-themed upscale restaurant featuring USDA Prime steaks, fresh Maine lobster, jumbo stone crab claws, and an extensive raw bar. Dine on the open-air waterfront deck and enjoy views of vintage amphicars giving water tours. One of Disney Springs' most celebrated dining destinations.
meals.dinner: Maria & Enzo's Ristorante at Disney Springs: An elegantly designed Italian restaurant inside a converted 1930s airline terminal with soaring ceilings and vintage aviation décor. Savor handmade pasta, wood-roasted branzino, and Sicilian-inspired desserts paired with an exceptional Italian wine list — a romantic and sophisticated finale dinner.

day_by_day.notes: Cirque du Soleil 'Drawn to Life' tickets must be purchased in advance — premium VIP seating packages include pre-show dining and exclusive viewing areas. Disney Springs is free to enter with no park ticket required. Parking is complimentary. Splitsville reservations are recommended for weekend visits. The Amphicar water tours at The Boathouse are a unique and memorable family activity — book upon arrival as they operate on a first-come basis.

day_by_day.morning: Farewell Magic Kingdom Morning — Bucket List Moments: Return to Magic Kingdom for one final morning of magic. Revisit your family's favorite attractions and take time for any experiences missed earlier in the week. Enjoy a leisurely walk down Main Street, U.S.A. for final photographs of Cinderella Castle. Visit the Bibbidi Bobbidi Boutique for a premium princess or knight transformation experience (ideal for younger guests). Collect final souvenirs from the Emporium.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Relaxation & Departure Preparation: Return to the boutique hotel for a final luxury afternoon. Enjoy the resort pool, spa facilities, or simply relax and reminisce about the week's magical experiences. Request a late checkout from the hotel concierge (typically available for premium guests). Begin packing and organize luggage for departure. Schedule your private luxury transfer back to Orlando International Airport.
day_by_day.evening: Departure: Arrange your private transfer to Orlando International Airport with ample time before your departure flight. Carry the magic of your premium Disney World experience home with you — and begin planning your return.

meals.breakfast: Victoria & Albert's at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa (Chef's Table Experience): Walt Disney World's only AAA Five Diamond restaurant and one of the finest dining experiences in the United States. The seven-course Chef's Table tasting menu features extraordinary ingredients including Wagyu beef, black truffles, caviar, and rare seasonal delicacies — paired with a world-class sommelier-selected wine pairing. A once-in-a-lifetime breakfast or brunch farewell experience. Note: Reservations open 60 days in advance and require a credit card hold.
meals.lunch: Steakhouse 71 at Disney's Contemporary Resort: A stylish 1970s-inspired steakhouse with premium USDA beef, fresh seafood, and classic American comfort elevated to fine dining standards. Enjoy a relaxed, sophisticated farewell lunch with beautiful views of Bay Lake.
meals.dinner: In-flight or airport dining at Orlando International Airport's premium lounges (The Club MCO or Priority Pass lounges). Alternatively, if the flight departs late evening, enjoy a final dinner at The Edison at Disney Springs — a whimsical industrial-era restaurant featuring craft cocktails, artisan charcuterie, and theatrical entertainment.

day_by_day.notes: Victoria & Albert's is the most exclusive and difficult reservation at Walt Disney World — book exactly 60 days in advance at 6:00 AM EST. Smart formal attire is required (no jeans, shorts, or sneakers). Children under 10 are not permitted. If traveling with young children, substitute with a character dining farewell at Chef Mickey's at the Contemporary Resort instead. Request a complimentary late checkout (subject to availability) through your boutique hotel concierge. Ensure all Lightning Lane, dining, and experience receipts are organized for any travel insurance reimbursement purposes.
